moments.text: Infrared view of plain grey sky inside corner brackets, heavily redacted. A tiny dot in a small box drifts from upper left onto the crosshair as the sensor centres it.
A bright flash, then the brackets drop away; the tiny object sits in a small box at the crosshair against lighter grey.
The view zooms in: the object is a bright shape with crossed glints and a short bright trail to its right, held in the box as zoom and contrast change.
The glints turn from a slanted cross to a flat horizontal shape, so the object appears to rotate in the box.
A second small bright dot enters at the top centre and drifts down-right across the view, slipping behind the lower-right black box at 74.5 s.
The first object fades from the box; by 78 s the box is gone and the view turns grainy around a dashed crosshair.
The picture flashes bright; the second dot reappears at lower right and climbs to the top centre, gone in about 0.7 s.
Contrast flickers bright and dark and a bright band appears along the bottom; the picture cuts to black at 83.5 s.

notes: Portrait 608x1080 frame: the picture is a small band in the middle, large black bars above and below not cropped (crop None).
